ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels across approximately 70% of the visible surface, with high-contrast low-intensity black pixel distributions occupying the remaining 30%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark pigmentation patch at the central peduncle junction; extensive network of fine, dark, unaligned linear markings radiating across the bright white surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and distinct vertex definition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) of varying pixel amplitudes; increased jaggedness and larger notches present at the lateral tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex sweep along the superior edges of both lobes, transitioning to a slight upward curvature at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast brown/orange textured pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive distribution of distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) intersecting the white pigmentation across the entire ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy linear scarring (rake marks) across the fluke surface; presence of epibiotic barnacle colonies at the distal lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density pattern of dark linear abrasions creating a 'scratched' texture against the predominantly white background.
